changes.title: Checkpoint: stop a running quick action, details in more places; server tests not run [skip ci]
changes.detail:
A recovery checkpoint at the end of a session. The work below is written and passes the frontend checks. It is NOT finished: the new server tests were never run and nothing here has been seen in a browser.

- A running quick action can be listed and stopped. A small in-memory server component, quick_action, tracks each run: run, list, stop and subscribe, administrators only, at most 20 runs, nothing written to disk, and no run survives a restart. The dialog has a Stop button and a "Running quick actions" list, also shown in the Actions tool. - The shared data table can open a detail row under a row. Automations, scripts, helpers and entities use it for "Show more details". - Quick buttons and details in more lists: logbook rows, the area and device pages' automation, script and scene lists, labels, floors, zones, people, users, dashboards, blueprints, tags, repairs and backups. A user's details show only safe fields, and a test proves no password or credential can appear. - The states tool opens on one entity when the link names it. - HANDOFF.md and CLOSEOUT_PROMPT.md describe the state at the stop.
